caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden chest of drawers, often referred to as a highboy, with an ornate design. The furniture piece is rendered in shades of reddish-brown wood with a polished surface. It features a total of eight drawers organized in two sections; the top section has five graduated drawers, and the lower section has three drawers, with the central lower drawer and the central drawer near the top each decorated with a carved shell motif. The drawers are equipped with gold-colored handles and escutcheons in decorative patterns. The top of the chest has a broken pediment with two spiral scrolls, a central finial, and two smaller finials on either side. The highboy stands on four cabriole legs, each ending in a ball-and-claw foot, and has carved details on the legs as well as along the skirt below the drawers. The background of the drawing is plain and beige, without any additional objects or patterns.
title: Highboy
